subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Investment Scams on Instagram
description: A quick win: understand Investment Scams on Instagram.

hook.text: Screenshots of huge trading profits. Luxury cars. 'DM me to learn how.' It's an investment scam.

buildup.text: Scammers show fake brokerage screenshots and rented luxury items to create an illusion of wealth.

discovery.text: Victims send money to 'invest' and see fake profits on a dashboard the scammer controls.

twist.text: When victims try to withdraw, they're told to pay 'fees' or 'taxes' — more money down the drain.

climax.text: Social media platforms profit from ads for these scams and are slow to remove them.

punchline.text: If the profits were real, they wouldn't need your money.

quiz.question: What happens when investment scam victims try to withdraw profits?
options: They're asked to pay more fees that they never recover
